en: Colorized historical view of a central town square with several ornate multi‑story buildings surrounding an open plaza. Dominating the scene is a large gabled building with a steep green roof and a clock tower rising from the center of the roof ridge. Pedestrians are scattered around the wide cobbled square under a clear sky. The words "Zwickau." and "Hauptmarkt." are printed at the top of the image.
